card.name: Partway through capitalized names
card.fires_on: Middle pieces of capitalized names and trial or drug names, such as the PO in MARIPOSA or OTO in OTOTOXICITY. Also some verbs in old poetry lines.

modes.label: Inside all-caps names
modes.description: A middle piece of an all-caps trial, drug, or warning term.

modes.label: Inside person or code names
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a proper name or code-name.
modes.example: Antoine<< Ar>>nauld in the year of his death

modes.label: Poetry verse words
modes.description: A verb or word in a line of classic poetry.
modes.example: Winter<< kept>> us warm, covering Earth in forget

card.writes: It seems to push toward continuing a name, and away from pieces like 'ber'.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a capitalized name, before the rest of the name is spelled out.
